paper_metadata.title: Intelligent optimized design of novel high-temperature titanium alloys

evidence.quote: Based on the existing typical high-temperature titanium alloy system Ti-Al-Sn-Zr-Mo-Si, elements Ta, Nb, B, and C are added.
The 10 alloying elements above were used as variables to define the composition space, as shown in Table 1
Thermodynamic calculations through JMatPro to explore the influences of elements such as Al, V, and Cr (Ti-Al-V alloys)
The FNN model established in this study demonstrates high accuracy in predicting the mechanical properties and microstructure of high-temperature titanium alloys.

The phase content, high-temperature strength, and creep life of the equilibrium state at 650°C for each composition were calculated using high-throughput methods from the titanium alloy database of the JMatPro software, and a total of 56,134 sets of data were collected
machine learning models were developed to assess the yield strength, creep life, and volume fraction of the α2 phase (Vα2) of alloys at 650°C
The α phase is a hexagonal close-packed structure and has a lower diffusion rate than the β phase
the β phase with a body-centered cubic structure
the volume fraction of the α 2 phase as outputs
Nb is a weaker β-stabilizing element, has similar electronegativity to Ti, and has a larger solidification in the α phase, which plays a good solid solution strengthening role

A small amount of B can markedly improve the microstructure by refining grains, increasing phase boundaries to impede dislocation movement, thereby enhancing the alloy's creep resistance and high-temperature strength
With the increase in the α 2 phase content, the yield strength and creep life of the optimized alloys increase significantly , indicating the strengthening ef fect of the α 2 phase.

machine_learning_models.name: feedforward neural network (FNN)
machine_learning_models.task: regression prediction of yield strength, creep life at 150 MPa, and α2 phase volume fraction at 650°C
inputs: alloy composition (Al, Sn, Zr, Mo, Si, Nb, Ta, B, C, Ti)
machine_learning_models.target: yield strength; creep life; α2 volume fraction

evidence.quote: A high-precision predictive model has been established, achieving R2 values exceeding 0.9, with mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) not exceeding 5 and 11, respectively

machine_learning_models.name: NSGA-II
machine_learning_models.task: multiobjective optimization of alloy composition to find Pareto front

machine_learning_models.validation: comparison of optimized values with JMatPro calculations

evidence.quote: The optimization module is nondominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) using FNN as the surrogate model, achieving the global search, finding the well-distributed Pareto front
